technical_analysis: Our Axiom Cortex™ vetting for Python focuses on real-world architectural decisions. We present a scenario requiring both a public-facing API and a high-performance ML model serving endpoint. Candidates must justify their framework choices—typically Django for the comprehensive public API and FastAPI for the low-latency model serving. Top nearshore Python developers will identify common `asyncio` pitfalls, like running blocking I/O calls in an async event loop, and implement correct asynchronous patterns. For the ML portion, they must discuss trade-offs between a simple FastAPI wrapper and a dedicated solution like NVIDIA Triton for GPU-bound models. The final architecture from our nearshore Python developers must demonstrate a clear separation of concerns and a strategy for achieving specific p95 latency SLOs. This ensures all nearshore Python developers are prepared for complex backend challenges.
